sections.section_title: Slave mode – combined reset + gated mode
sections.text_helper: Section 56.4.19 "Slave mode – combined reset + gated mode" in chapter 56 (General-purpose timers (TIM9/TIM10/TIM11/TIM12/TIM13/TIM14)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2789.
sections.section_content:
The counter clock is enabled when the trigger input (tim_trgi) is high. The counter stops and
is reset) as soon as the trigger becomes low. Both start and stop of the counter are
controlled.
